# PublishRank

> PublishRank is a free, open-source WordPress SEO plugin for news publishers, online newspapers and bloggers. It covers news and XML sitemaps, connected structured data, breadcrumbs, redirects, crawl optimization, llms.txt discovery, Google Preferred Sources, a newsroom workspace and login protection.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/): Overview, screenshots and FAQ
- [Features](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/features): The complete list of 222 capabilities
- [Documentation](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/documentation): Setup, configuration and error reference
- [Comparisons](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/comparisons): PublishRank vs Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress and All in One SEO
- [Download](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/download): Latest release and install guide
- [Contact](https://publishrankseo.vercel.app/contact): Questions, bug reports and partnerships
